lines: NRJN Family Trust, represented by Entrust Family Office Legal & Trusteeship Services Private Limited, may have up to ₹141.96 crore from the offer, if all offered shares are sold.
The trigger is old: the proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago, so this is not a recent event.
Gain is unknown because the average cost of acquisition is not verified; the pre-offer holding is also unknown.
Proceeds are slightly lower than shown, as employee-portion shares sell at a discount. Confidence is medium.
